key_insights: Mao is a LOCAL ONLY terminal application like Claude Code
NOT a web service, API provider, or cloud application
Architecture: TypeScript/Node.js terminal UI + Python backend + External API calls
Communication: Node.js ↔ Python via subprocess, Python → External APIs via HTTP
Data storage: Local files only, no remote databases
Think 'desktop app' not 'web app', 'subprocess calls' not 'API calls'
critical_principles: LOCAL FIRST - user owns data and processing
Subprocess communication between UI and backend
Personal productivity tool, not multi-user service
All documentation must reinforce LOCAL application concept
architecture_principles_summary.comparison_analogy: Like VSCode/Claude Code/Photoshop, NOT like GitHub Codespaces/Figma/Google Docs
